searchText: I’m attempting to understand what liabilities uTP may have relative to NAT traversal and firewalls. It appears to be well understood by and solved within the torrent file sharing community, so I’m hunting for and reviewing their implementation strategies this weekend. This, albeit dated, is also quite helpful: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5128

I’m attempting to understand what liabilities uTP may have relative to NAT traversal and firewalls. It appears to be well understood by and solved within the torrent file sharing community, so I’m hunting for and reviewing their implementation strategies this weekend.

This, albeit dated, is also quite helpful: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5128
